caption:
"Between you and I" is wrong.

After to, for, with, or between, use me/him/her/us/them. Drop the other person: "to Priya and I" → "to I"? Nope. It's "to Priya and me."

Send this to a friend who says "between you and I."
tiktok_caption: "Between you and I" is wrong. Drop the other person to check.

youtube.title: I vs. Me on the SAT: The Drop-the-Name Test
youtube.description: After a preposition, use the object pronoun. Drop the other person from the phrase and listen.
